_comment: What each provider is used with when the config names a provider but no model, and the similarity cutoff each embedding model is calibrated at. These are values, not reasons: why gpt-oss-120b rather than llama-3.3-70b, and why the two thresholds are 0.53 and 0.68 rather than one number, is in docs/architecture.md §5 under 'Provider defaults'. Adding a provider means a row here plus a branch in bootstrap.build_llm.
